core_capabilities_used: finite constructor tags and ordered fields

B-TYPED-MAP.construction: raw domain/codomain carriers + APPLY graph + FORALL/EXISTS totality/partial-domain clause + EQUAL uniqueness

B-OPERATION-LAW.construction: n-ary operation = typed map from indexed product; laws are Core quantified formulas

B-SUBOBJECT-QUOTIENT.construction: subcarrier predicate/inclusion + equivalence relation laws + quotient carrier/projection characterized by q(x)=q(y) iff E(x,y) and surjectivity

B-INDEXED-FAMILY.construction: projection total->base; fiber = preimage; section/pullback/restriction expressed by maps and equalities

B-ADDITIVE-SCALAR.construction: two operation maps plus quantified additive/scalar/distributive laws; exact coefficient construction needs number/index authority

B-MULTILINEAR-FORM.construction: typed multi-argument map plus linearity/symmetry/conjugation/positivity laws

B-INVOLUTION-GRADING.construction: typed finite-order map + composition/equality; fixed/eigenspace carriers as subcarriers; grading indexed by finite carrier

B-TOPOLOGY-LIMIT.construction: carrier of neighborhoods/open regions plus membership/closure laws; convergence/limit as quantified relation; completion as schema, not primitive leaf

B-DIFFERENTIAL.construction: typed map with linearity and derivation/nilpotence/composition laws; chains/kernels/images/quotients use generic schemas

B-AGGREGATE.construction: measure/aggregate as typed map/functionals with additivity/linearity/normalization laws; concrete analytic instances remain separate qualification burdens

B-PARITY-GRADED.construction: two-class index carrier plus parity/sign law over generic operations

B-FINITE-PRODUCT-INDEX.reason: Core K8 explicitly excludes cardinality/arithmetic; Core K7 requires base/successor and inductive/well-founded carrier authority. Generic finite arity, dimension, cardinality and exact coefficient/index semantics cannot be hidden in literals or relation names.

first_required_independent_module.name: Domain-Neutral Index and Arithmetic 0.1
first_required_independent_module.purpose: Supply only the inductive/counting/arithmetic data semantics forced by the demand graph: natural index carrier, zero/successor, induction/well-founded authority, finite index segments, addition, multiplication, order, exact finite cardinality and rational-literal construction.
prohibited_scope: no W or L source-object identities
first_required_independent_module.historical_evidence_only: research/primitive-logic/PRIMITIVE_NATURAL_ARITHMETIC_* may be inspected as prior research but is not authority and must not be promoted without fresh derivation/qualification.

consequence: Do not add new semantic Core primitive IDs for W/L at this stage. Qualify DNIA independently, then qualify the remaining graph-derived generic schemas as schema modules over Core+DNIA. Re-run demand coverage afterward.
downstream_block: W and L must not consume DNIA or any generic schema until independent module qualification is complete.
